summary: Seven unique executed retail Phoenix leases within 8 miles and inside the 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31 window met all data requirements (R1695 with duplicate R2614, R3353, R2434, R1930, R6289, R8772, R5747). Ranking by distance ascending (then latest lease date) yields a five-comp shortlist: R1695 (0.80 mi, 21.00 face, 11.28 effective net $/sf/yr, 36 mo), R3353 (1.03 mi, 22.44 face, 16.93, 48 mo, amended free rent 4 months and TI 18 per U-R3353-1), R2434 (1.26 mi, 22.60 face, 19.41, 60 mo), R1930 (1.49 mi, 24.12 face, 9.47, 36 mo), and R6289 (1.72 mi, 24.20 face, 22.12, 48 mo). R8772 and R5747 qualified but fell outside the five slots. Effective rents use the stated undiscounted client convention (2.5% escalations at months 13/25/37/49, free rent at the front, gross expenses deducted every month, TI subtracted once) and are not appraisal-grade values. Excluded records failed on date (R7254), radius (R8177), asset type (R9966), status (R7345, R3964), post-cutoff publication (R9256), or missing/zero required inputs (R3442 TI, R5629 free months, R1009 term, R7377 rent, R5471 gross expenses, R7562 zero rent).
limitations: No workbook or CSV was produced: artifact creation is outside this direct API control, so the comp grid exists only as the JSON shortlist above.

All base extracts share a single publication date (2026-08-15) and no underlying lease documents were provided; face rents, free rent, TI and expense figures are taken at face value from the abstracts.
Effective net rents follow the prescribed undiscounted rent-only convention (no time value, no leasing commissions, no downtime or credit adjustment) and are not market value indications.

R2434's face rent may be superseded: executed amendment U-R2434-2 lowers rent_quote to 2 (unit unstated) effective 2026-09-10, after the cutoff, so the shortlist value could be stale for post-cutoff use.
R1930's free rent is contested by unsigned draft U-R1930-3 (8 months); if executed, its effective net rent would fall materially.

Duplicate entity BIRCH-REN-46690 appears as R1695 and R2614 with identical terms; R1695 was treated as primary because R2614 is labelled a second source of the same underlying record. No sponsor/parent-SPV mappings were supplied in the packet, so no SPV consolidation was needed.
NNN records list annual_expenses_psf as null; per the convention the NNN deduction is zero, but the true reimbursable load is unknown.
Distances are as supplied (miles) and were not independently verified; no address, tenant, landlord or contact details were provided or asserted.
R9256 (published after cutoff) and R8177 (18.6 mi) could change conclusions if the cutoff or radius were relaxed.
